scope: One sequential pair, Vulkan 1920x1080, animated 3D, 36000 identical scene/model ticks, 6000 soak name updates, 20 measured preparation cycles. Both arms warm the same resources; baseline destroys UI before soak.
limitations: Fixed workload count, not equal wall time or randomized repeated trials.
All process memory includes engine, renderer, allocator and warmed global font resources.
The retained-UI arm also performs modal toggles and HUD checks absent from the baseline.
Absolute process memory and differences between arm deltas do not isolate live UI allocations.
This pair does not prove an indefinite memory bound or explain the earlier 19 MiB increase.
